mapper.insert: INSERT INTO voyage ( voyage_number, carrier_code, carrier_name, vessel_name, departure_unlocode, arrival_unlocode, departure_at, arrival_at, cancelled, registered_at, projected_at, last_event_id, updated_at, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{voyageNumber}, #{carrierCode}, #{carrierName}, #{vesselName}, #{departureUnlocode}, #{arrivalUnlocode}, #{departureAt}, #{arrivalAt}, #{cancelled}, #{registeredAt}, #{projectedAt}, #{lastEventId}, #{updatedAt}, #{updatedBy} ) ON CONFLICT (voyage_number) DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO voyage_accepted_cargo_type (voyage_number, cargo_type) VALUES (#{voyageNumber}, #{cargoType}) ON CONFLICT (voyage_number, cargo_type) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE voyage SET carrier_code = #{carrierCode}, carrier_name = #{carrierName}, vessel_name = #{vesselName}, departure_unlocode = #{departureUnlocode}, arrival_unlocode = #{arrivalUnlocode}, departure_at = #{departureAt}, arrival_at = #{arrivalAt}, projected_at = #{projectedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE voyage_number = #{voyageNumber}
UPDATE voyage SET cancelled = TRUE, cancelled_at = #{cancelledAt}, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, cancelled_by = #{cancelledBy}, projected_at = #{projectedAt} WHERE voyage_number = #{voyageNumber}
